items.title: 68154_Gus Johnson oral history interview
items.q: I wrote out the lead and the chords and gave it to Skippy Hall, and he made an arrangement for the band.

ctx.x: The World's Greatest Jazz Band played it. MacShann played it in front, when the first time I did it, Skippy Hall made an arrangement for the big band.
Oh, yeah. And so Mac was the first one to play it.
